fixtures.main_product_context: A 3D printed mahjong tile rack set shown with pink racks and mahjong tiles on green felt.
fixtures.notes: THE fix target. Composed listing graphic (teal sales banner + rack diagram), misrepresents the product. Production over-scored it 6.0; supporting-v7 alone still let the model rate it 6.8-7.3 (it would not score Accuracy low). Adding the supporting-v8 is_marketing_graphic WORKED EXAMPLE moved it: the model now flags the composite (as marketing-graphic / wrong-product) and it lands ~3.5 WEAK. The model's exact upload_kind/supporting_role for this composite is unstable run-to-run (digital_preview vs unrelated_or_wrong_product); band=weak is the assertion that matters.

fixtures.main_product_context: A 3D printed mahjong tile rack set shown with pink racks and mahjong tiles on green felt.
fixtures.notes: The worse AI-'improved' version of the graphic (production 3.9, below the 6.0 original; ~3.1 under supporting-v8). Confirms the generator cannot turn a marketing graphic into a good clean photo, which is exactly why one-click fix is now gated off for graphics. upload_kind unstable run-to-run; band=weak is the assertion.

The composed listing graphic scored through the MAIN rubric (main-v13 is_marketing_graphic contract). The CRITICAL check this guards is the false-positive risk: the ordinary main photos (customer1-main-original / -improved) must flag is_marketing_graphic=false so One-click is never wrongly disabled on a real photo (verified). Main-photo true-positive detection is intentionally weak (no main worked example): the model often classifies a composed graphic-as-main as digital_product and scores it low, which the digital server gate + low score already handle. band/upload_kind are not the assertion; the graphic flag on ordinary mains is.
